answer: We bind each agent identity to a unique proof-of-work nonce that a falcon-shaped VDF puzzle enforces, so spawning sybils costs real sequential time rather than a garden of free keys. Asynchronous Byzantine consensus then commits a state-machine invariant tying stake to nonce lineage, letting honest peers forge a quorum certificate that excludes duplicate roots. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
